title: Extraction envelope
description: What the model returns: the document data plus a confidence per field. `data` is checked against the document type's own schema.

data.description: An instance of the document type's schema.

confidence.description: How sure the model is about each extracted field.

field.description: Dotted path with zero-based indices, e.g. vendor.gstin or line_items.0.amount.amount.

score.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that the value is correct.
